note: The auditable record of which RPCS3 frame backs which Tier B cell. Authored from what each batch's MANIFEST.md says the frame shows (the manifest section is cited in every note), not from file names. `entries` is the input to work/parity-import.ts; the importer rewrites each entry's `applied` block with the cell, the destination reference and provenance paths, and the source and destination sha256 (identity: the importer copies or hard-links, it never converts). An entry's `replaced` field records a deliberate re-import of the same source into the same cell - here the batch was imported twice on 2026-10-27 because the first sidecars carried the manifest's typography and the corpus is ASCII; the source frame did not change. The images stay under out/parity-references/, which .gitignore excludes, so this file is the committed part: paths and hashes, never firmware pixels.
